title: Energy efficiency of the world's fastest computer, 2002–2026 (log scale)
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale of the energy efficiency, in billions of floating-point operations per second per watt (gigaflops per watt), of each TOP500 No. 1 system whose power was reported, in the list where it first took first place: Earth Simulator (June 2002) 0.011; Roadrunner (June 2008) 0.44; K computer (June 2011) 0.82; Sunway TaihuLight (June 2016) 6.1; Fugaku (June 2020) 14.7; Frontier (June 2022) 52.2; El Capitan (November 2024) 58.9; LineShine (June 2026) 52.1. Computed from each list's Rmax (HPL benchmark) and reported power. Data: TOP500.org.
heading: FASTEST MACHINE · GIGAFLOPS PER WATT · LOG SCALE
